description: baseline: LightGBM with 5-fold stratified CV on Titanic (N=891) with rich feature engineering — Title from Name, Deck from Cabin, Ticket prefix, family-size features, missingness indicators, and log-Fare; ensemble of 5 fold models for robust val AUC on this small dataset.

Richer feature engineering (ticket frequency, fare-per-person, title-based age imputation, Sex×Pclass interactions, age bins, cabin count, Title_Pclass combo); full-dataset 5-fold OOF CV (all 891 samples used for evaluation instead of 20% holdout); better LightGBM params (num_leaves=63, lr=0.03, 3000 trees with early stopping)

** Ensemble of LightGBM + XGBoost + CatBoost (simple average of OOF predictions) with new features: WomenOrChild flag, Fare percentile rank within Pclass, WomanChild×Pclass interaction, AloneMan, FamilySize×Pclass — diversity across three GBM families should push AUC above 0.869.

Fold-safe target encoding for Title/Deck/Embarked/Ticket_prefix/Title_Pclass inside each CV fold (converts ordinal labels to survival-rate signals without leakage), plus new structural features: Surname_freq, SibSp×Parch, Age², Age×IsWoman, FamilySize×IsWoman, TicketFamilyDiff, IsNonFamilyGroup; keeps LGB+XGB+CatBoost ensemble

Added RandomForest + ExtraTrees as base models and stacked all 5 models (LGB+XGB+CatBoost+RF+ET) with a Logistic Regression meta-learner evaluated via honest OOF 5-fold CV, targeting improved ensemble diversity beyond the 0.896 GBM-only average.

Optuna-tuned hyperparameters for LGB/XGB/CatBoost (40+30+20 trials), added Surname_size feature and Surname_size×IsWoman interaction, switched from simple-average to rank-based ensemble to normalize score distributions across model families.

Add LGB-DART (25 Optuna trials) as 4th ensemble member, increase LGB/XGB/CAT Optuna trials to 60/50/35, add SibSp_x_Parch/Has_Parch/IsAlone_x_Pclass features, use AUC^4-weighted rank ensemble for 4-model blend

Multi-seed OOF averaging (5 seeds per model) for variance reduction, Optuna-optimized ensemble weights (200 trials), plus IsMother and IsChild_x_Pclass domain features targeting lifeboat prioritization signals

Add sklearn MLPClassifier (128→64→32, L2 reg, early stopping) as a genuinely different 4th ensemble member to increase diversity beyond correlated GBMs, plus new features: ticket group composition (all-women flag, women fraction, has-child flag), ordinal deck encoding (A=7 top to G=1 bottom), Age², and deck×Pclass/womenFrac×Pclass interactions.

Add SVM (RBF kernel, 20 Optuna trials) and Logistic Regression (10 Optuna trials) as 5th and 6th ensemble members with genuinely different decision boundaries (distance/margin-based vs linear), testing 6 ensemble combinations (3-GBM to 6-model) and reporting the best to maximize diversity-driven AUC gains beyond 0.899

Add Optuna-tuned MLP architecture search (15 trials), Optuna-optimized 4-model ensemble weights (300 trials), and 2 new Titanic domain features (SibSp×IsWoman, SmallFamily) to push beyond 0.899 equal-weight ensemble

Add meta-LGB stacking (25 Optuna trials) + polynomial degree-2 LogisticRegressionCV stacker on OOF predictions (non-linear vs linear blending comparison), 2 new features (IsFemaleChild, TicketGroup_MinPclass), and increased Optuna trials (LGB=50, XGB=40, CAT=25, weights=400)

Replace sklearn MLP with PyTorch ResNet MLP (skip connections, BatchNorm, GPU) for richer capacity + add new features (CabinNum, TicketGroupAvgAge, IsFemaleAdult, IsCouple) to push diversity beyond the GBM+sklearn-MLP ensemble

Multi-seed OOF averaging (seeds 42/123/456) for all 4 models to reduce variance in OOF estimates, tuning hyperparameters once with seed=42 then evaluating across 3 seeds — a principled variance reduction approach distinct from exp7 which did multi-seed during Optuna tuning; also increased Optuna trials (LGB 40→50, XGB 30→40, CAT 20→25, MLP 15→20) for better hyperparameter coverage.

Add Logistic Regression with degree-2 polynomial interaction features as 5th diverse model (smooth quadratic boundaries complement GBM step-functions and MLP non-linearities), plus IsInfant feature and 5-model Optuna weight optimization (400 trials)

Replace LR+Poly (which failed with syntax error) with ExtraTreesClassifier as 5th ensemble member (bagging diversity vs GBM boosting), increase Optuna trials, optimize both 4-model and 5-model ensemble weights and report the best

Fix truncated train.py by restoring proven exp10 base (0.902430) and add HistGradientBoostingClassifier (sklearn's depth-wise boosted trees — different algorithm/regularization from LGB/XGB/CatBoost) as 5th ensemble member plus IsInfant/IsFemaleChild domain features; optimize both 4-model and 5-model Optuna ensemble weights (500 trials each) and report the best.

Restore clean best_train.py (0.902430) with 3 targeted improvements: fix duplicate Woman_Pclass feature, add IsInfant/IsFemaleChild domain features, and add CMA-ES weight optimization alongside TPE (CMA-ES excels at continuous 4D spaces like ensemble weight blending)

Restore complete train.py from best_train.py base (fixing truncation), remove duplicate SexPclass/Woman_Pclass feature, add IsInfant/IsFemaleChild domain features, and switch to 10-fold CV (from 5-fold) with proportionally reduced Optuna trials (25/20/12/10 vs 40/30/20/15) — 10-fold gives more training data per fold (90% vs 80%) and more stable OOF estimates for the small N=891 dataset while keeping the same total OOF evaluation size.

Restore 5-fold CV (key regression fix from 10-fold→0.893), increase Optuna trials to match exp10 levels, add ExtraTrees as 5th ensemble member with separate 4-model and 5-model Optuna weight optimization to capture bagging diversity not found in GBMs+MLP
